issue_title: [Perf] _sanitize_text 对超长文本可能存在性能问题
approach: Replace character-by-character iteration with str.translate() using a pre-built translation table

changes.description: Optimized _sanitize_text using str.translate() with pre-built translation table at module load time
Added performance regression tests verifying 1MB text processes in < 100ms

risks: None identified - str.translate is well-tested Python stdlib function
